name.local: 財團法人生物技術開發中心

funds.name: 生鵬一號基金 (ShengPeng No.1 Fund)

strategy.thesis: DCB is Taiwan's longstanding government-linked biotech R&D and technology-transfer research institute (財團法人); in 2021 it broke through restrictions under the Foundations Act to launch the NT$2B 'ShengPeng No.1' venture fund, co-investing with the National Development Fund and other domestic/international partners to back new-drug, cell/gene-therapy and medtech spinouts emerging from its own labs and Taiwan's broader biotech ecosystem.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Operates the NBIC (New Bio-industry Incubation Center) incubation/lab-space program and is commissioned by Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs to run the 生技醫藥產業發展推動小組 (Biotech/Pharma Industry Development Promotion Group), which coordinates cross-ministry support for domestic biotech/pharma industry development.

sources.title: 打破限制 生技中心將設創投基金
sources.supports: 生鵬一號基金 NT$2B fund size, founding rationale, National Development Fund co-investment
sources.quote: 生技中心推出生技投資基金「生鵬一號基金」，初期募集20億元...基金來源邀請國內民間資金外，也將邀請國發基金一起成立「生鵬一號基金」

sources.title: 新創事業/育成中心
sources.publisher: 財團法人生物技術開發中心 (DCB)
sources.supports: DCB's incubation center offers investment planning, project-sourcing and financing-partner services to portfolio startups

verification_notes: Fund existence, size and NDF co-investment corroborated by 經濟日報/UDN reporting (2021 announcement); DCB's own incubation-center page confirms investment-facilitation services but does not name the fund on the pages fetched. Reported foreign (Japan/Singapore) co-investor interest in press could not be independently verified.

summary.en: Taiwan's DCB (Biotechnology Development Center), a government-linked biotech R&D institute, runs the NT$2B 'ShengPeng No.1' venture fund plus an incubation program (NBIC) to finance and commercialize new-drug, cell/gene-therapy and medtech spinouts.
summary.local: 生物技術開發中心（DCB）為台灣資深生技研發與技轉法人，2021年突破財團法人法限制成立20億元「生鵬一號基金」，並透過NBIC育成中心支持新藥、細胞基因治療與醫材新創商業化。

name.en: BioHub Taiwan (National Biotechnology Research Park Incubation & Service Center)
name.local: 國家生技研究園區 創服育成中心

aka: 中研院生醫轉譯研究中心創服育成專題中心

strategy.thesis: Operated by Academia Sinica's BioTReC (生醫轉譯研究中心) inside the National Biotechnology Research Park (Nangang), BioHub Taiwan connects biomedical startups spinning out of academic/research-institute science with incubation space, government resources, and domestic/international early-stage investors and biotech VC funds, focused on new-drug development, smart medicine and precision medicine.

sources.title: 創服育成中心- 台北
sources.publisher: 國家生技研究園區 (National Biotechnology Research Park), Academia Sinica

sources.title: 創服育成專題中心
sources.publisher: 中央研究院生醫轉譯研究中心 (BioTReC, Academia Sinica)
sources.supports: founding date, operating unit, investment-matchmaking role
sources.quote: BioHub Taiwan 於 2018 年 10 月成立，而中研院生醫轉譯研究中心創服育成專題中心於 2019 年 9 月開始正式成立與運作，擔負規劃及營運 BioHub Taiwan 之任務。

verification_notes: Functions primarily as an incubation/lab-space center run by Academia Sinica (a national research institute) that facilitates matchmaking with domestic/international biotech VC funds and early-stage investors; it does not appear to deploy its own direct investment fund based on the pages reviewed.

summary.en: BioHub Taiwan is Academia Sinica's incubation and startup-services center at the National Biotechnology Research Park in Taipei, pairing biomedical spinouts with lab space and investor introductions across new-drug, smart-medicine and precision-medicine fields.
summary.local: 國家生技研究園區創服育成中心（BioHub Taiwan）由中央研究院生醫轉譯研究中心負責規劃營運，於南港國家生技研究園區提供生醫新創空間、資源媒合及投資引介，聚焦新藥開發、智慧醫療與精準醫療。

strategy.thesis: Founded in 2018 by National Chiao Tung University (now merged into National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University) alumni together with Sunplus and Hanmoon Technology, GlintMED runs a biomedical/medical-materials accelerator that leverages NYCU's combined medical (Yang Ming) and semiconductor/ICT (Chiao Tung) research base, partnering with hospitals such as Taipei Veterans General Hospital and China Medical University Hospital for clinical mentorship.

program.eligibility: Biotechnology and medical-materials companies; applicants must be recommended
perks: mentorship from physicians, professors and IPO-experienced founders

sources.title: 醫智亮加速器 - 整合生醫資源，新創加速力量
交大X陽明 生技醫療加速器的「新創」之旅－醫智亮加速器公司執行長胡瑞卿專訪
sources.supports: founding by NCTU/NYCU alumni, 2018 origin, founder background
sources.quote: 交大X陽明 生技醫療加速器的「新創」之旅－醫智亮加速器公司執行長胡瑞卿專訪

verification_notes: Functions primarily as a structured mentorship/training accelerator; public pages do not clearly disclose whether GlintMED itself makes direct equity investments (CEO Hu Rui-qing has a VC background at Hanmoon Technology) — treat any capital-deployment claims as unverified.

summary.en: GlintMED is a biomedical/medtech accelerator founded in 2018 by NYCU (Yang Ming Chiao Tung University) alumni and corporate partners, running an intensive training and mentorship program for biotech and medical-materials startups in partnership with Taiwanese teaching hospitals.
summary.local: 醫智亮加速器（GlintMED）由陽明交大（原交大）校友與產業夥伴於2018年共同創立，提供生技與醫材新創密集培訓課程與臨床導師輔導，並與國內教學醫院合作。

name.local: 臺北醫學大學生醫加速器

strategy.thesis: Run by Taipei Medical University's Business Development Office (alongside TMU SPARK tech transfer and the Biodesign Center), TMU BioMed Accelerator is billed as Taiwan's first international-level medical-university accelerator, giving digital-health, medical-AI and medical-device startups access to TMU's clinical/hospital network, physician mentors, and a capital component, in partnership with HealthTech/MedTech venture builder BE Accelerator.

sources.title: TMU BioMed Accelerator - 1st Batch Program
sources.supports: program focus areas (digital health, medical AI, medical devices), TMU Business Development Office ownership, BE Accelerator partnership

sources.title: 臺北醫學大學事業發展處
sources.publisher: Taipei Medical University Business Development Office
sources.supports: organizational placement of BioMed Accelerator under TMU's Business Development Office alongside TMU SPARK and Biodesign Center

verification_notes: Secondary summary of program materials referenced access to 'the BioMed Accelerator's venture capital fund' for participating startups, but exact fund size, vintage year, and per-startup check size are not disclosed on the public pages reviewed within the research budget.

summary.en: TMU BioMed Accelerator is Taipei Medical University's biomedical accelerator, connecting digital-health, medical-AI and medical-device startups to TMU's hospital network, physician mentors and startup capital as part of the university's broader Business Development Office (TMU SPARK / Biodesign Center) ecosystem.
summary.local: 臺北醫學大學生醫加速器隸屬北醫事業發展處（與TMU SPARK技轉、Biodesign Center並列），提供數位健康、醫療AI與醫材新創臨床場域、醫師導師與創業資金資源。

strategy.thesis: Launched in July 2024 by Taiwan's National Development Council (NDC) together with National Taiwan University as Taiwan's first university alumni-run VC fund, seeded with a NT$1B first close (NDC/National Development Fund committing roughly 30%, remainder raised by NTU from alumni and its network) to back NTU faculty/student/alumni spinouts across deep-tech verticals including life sciences, alongside AI, robotics, semiconductors and materials/energy.

sources.title: 帶動校園創業風潮 國發會聯手台大成立校友VC投資基金
sources.supports: fund size NT$1B, NDF ~30% contribution, NTU alumni fundraising
sources.quote: 國發會將聯手台大成立台灣第一個校友VC投資基金，基金規模十億元，國發基金將投資三成，其他資金由台大找尋校友及台大網絡募集。

sources.title: 國發會點火創業揪校友設基金 台大先鋒首期規模10億
sources.supports: NT$1B first-phase fund size, framing as first university alumni VC fund

sources.title: 國發會點火創業揪校友設基金 台大先鋒首期規模10億
sources.supports: corroborates NT$1B fund size and July 2024 announcement

verification_notes: Announced July 2024 as a joint NDC-NTU initiative; the NDC primary press release (ndc.gov.tw) returned HTTP 403 on fetch attempt, so this entry relies on corroborating udn.com/money.udn.com/CNA news snippets. Colloquial press name '台大先鋒基金' may not be the fund's formal registered name. Investment scope spans multiple deep-tech verticals, of which life sciences is only one; not a health-exclusive fund.

summary.en: The NTU Alumni Venture Capital Fund is Taiwan's first university-alumni-run VC fund, launched July 2024 by the National Development Council and National Taiwan University with a NT$1B first close, backing NTU-affiliated deep-tech spinouts including life sciences alongside AI, robotics and semiconductors.
summary.local: 台大校友創投基金為台灣首個大學校友創投基金，2024年7月由國發會攜手台大成立，首期規模10億元，投資對象為台大師生校友創業團隊，領域涵蓋生醫等深科技。

aka: 陽明交大天使投資俱樂部

strategy.thesis: An alumni-founded angel investment club of National Chiao Tung University (merged into National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University in 2021), historically diversified but now redirecting new investment focus toward medtech and digital health, leveraging the merged university's combined medical (Yang Ming) and ICT/semiconductor (Chiao Tung) research base.

sources.title: 交大天使投資俱樂部
sources.supports: identity, founding by NCTU alumni, portfolio company list

sources.title: 交大天使投資首個出場案——晉弘科技表現亮眼即將興櫃
sources.supports: founding by NCTU alumni, ~26-30 portfolio companies, capital deployed (NT$500M+) and follow-on capital attracted (NT$3B+)
sources.quote: 交大天使投資俱樂部是由國立交通大學校友發起組成...已經投資26個新創公司，總投資額超過新台幣5億元，引發跟投資金超過30億元

sources.title: 台灣天使俱樂部／台灣全球天使投資俱樂部
sources.publisher: 環球生技月刊 (GlobalBio / GBI Monthly)
sources.supports: post-NYCU-merger strategic pivot toward medtech/digital-health investing
sources.quote: 在陽明交大合併之後，加上科技產業投資生醫領域的熱潮，該俱樂部的投資重點將是運用數位科技如物聯網、人工智慧的醫療科技與數位健康領域

verification_notes: Historically a broadly diversified angel portfolio (software, IoT, fintech, sustainability, some biotech/medtech); the medical/digital-health nexus described here is a recent post-merger strategic pivot reported by 環球生技月刊, not the club's sole historical focus. Founding year is inconsistently stated on the club's own site (2009 in one section, 2012 in another), so founded_year is omitted pending clarification.

summary.en: The NCTU/NYCU Angel Club is an alumni-run angel investment club of National Chiao Tung University (now part of NYCU) with 30+ portfolio companies and over NT$500M deployed; following NYCU's merger it is reorienting new investments toward medtech and digital health.
summary.local: 交大天使投資俱樂部由國立交通大學校友發起，已投資逾30家新創、投入資金超過新台幣5億元；陽明交大合併後，投資重點轉向醫療科技與數位健康領域。
